observations.claim: Valid generated candidates 2/2. Incumbent 11.45280 to 11.31618. The winner improved to 11.31618. Its in-route divisor is the current node's depot distance, common to all candidates, so it cancels in the ranking; the effective changes are the distance and demand coefficients.

hypotheses.claim: Adjusting a term that actually changes ranking is more informative than changing a positive common divisor.

next_search_advice.direction: Modify one effective coefficient without changing common scaling.
